author: @maya_codes
text: Just got the Acme Phone X. Battery dies before lunch. Truly innovative.

author: @nightowlphoto
text: The new Acme camera is genuinely the first time I've enjoyed taking low-light photos. Wow.

author: @dadof3
text: On hold with @AcmeSupport for 47 minutes. This is fine.

author: @frugal_finn
text: $1299 for a phone that creaks when I hold it. Acme really said 'pay us to beta-test'.

author: @karaonthego
text: Switched from a Pixel to the Acme last week. Honestly? The screen is gorgeous and the haptics feel premium.

author: @dev_jpark
text: Acme's update broke my fingerprint sensor. Cool cool cool.

author: @quietreader
text: Bought Acme. Fine I guess. Does what a phone does.

author: @runner_kira
text: Acme fitness tracking is finally accurate on hill repeats. Small thing, made my whole morning.

author: @frustrated_dan
text: Three Acme repairs in six months. I am DONE.

author: @sasha_designs
text: Acme's new minimalist UI is a masterclass in restraint. Other vendors take note.

author: @marc_t
text: Spent two hours with @AcmeSupport. They told me to factory reset. Twice. Lost my photos.

author: @amir_b
text: Acme's price is steep but the build quality justifies it for me.

author: @late_to_tech
text: Acme keeps draining battery in standby. Anyone else? Last 3 firmware updates have been rough.

author: @yara_writes
text: Loving the new Acme. Great keyboard, lovely display. Worth every penny.

author: @chronic_coder
text: Acme support replied in 3 minutes and shipped a replacement same day. Did not expect that. Quietly impressed.

author: @gpu_gabby
text: Zenith Laptop runs my models 30% faster than my old machine. Real engineering.

author: @hot_take_henry
text: Zenith's keyboard is mushy garbage. How did this ship?

author: @edu_em
text: My Zenith fan sounds like a hairdryer under any load. Beautiful machine if you live in a wind tunnel.

author: @nomad_no
text: Zenith battery actually does the advertised 16 hours. Shocked, in a good way.

author: @security_sven
text: Zenith shipped with telemetry on by default. Off-putting first impression.

author: @doc_dora
text: Zenith trackpad is the best I've used since the 2015 MacBook. Genuinely happy.

author: @anon_ant
text: Returning my Zenith. Three crashes in the first day. Zero confidence.

author: @cli_charlie
text: Zenith Linux drivers landed faster than I expected. Pleasant surprise.

author: @rant_ruby
text: @ZenithSupport told me my warranty is voided because I 'used the wrong charger'. The one in the box.

author: @calm_kai
text: Zenith's new model is fine. Not amazing, not terrible. Solid for the money.

author: @studio_sam
text: Zenith color accuracy out of the box is incredible for a non-pro panel. Editing photos has never been easier.

author: @bus_brian
text: $2400 for a laptop and the hinge is already loose after two weeks. Build quality is a joke.

author: @thoughtful_t
text: Zenith's customer service apologised, escalated, and refunded me within an hour. Felt heard.

author: @gamer_gina
text: Zenith thermal throttling kicks in after 8 minutes of any sustained workload. So much for 'workstation class'.

author: @neutral_nia
text: Got a Zenith. Box was clean. Setup was fine. No strong feelings yet.
